description: chair is a Pure Data library containing abstractions and utilities for audio processing, synthesis, and sensor/parameter mapping developed by CHAIR (Center for Haptic Audio Interaction Research) for use with interactive audio and haptic hardware like the Tickle.

research.notes: The library is published on Deken under the package name 'chair' by CHAIR (Center for Haptic Audio Interaction Research) and maintained in the official GitHub repository chairaudio/CHAIR-Pd-library.
